FortiOS 8.0.0 New Features: control when custom commands are pushed
targets.notes: Focuses on per-serial binding and on-replay/on-any push semantics; command executes last after controller configuration.

guides_checked: FortiWiFi and FortiAP Configuration Guide 8.0.0: DHCP snooping and Option 82 data insertion

targets.notes: Requires FortiAP firmware 7.6.4+; Circuit ID can combine AP MAC/model/hostname/SSID/VLAN/WTP profile and Remote ID can include client MAC.

targets.selected: Nested group graph integrity and circular-membership failure
targets.notes: Primary content explains typed nested groups and policy/role use; community article is scenario-only and dated Oct 9 (outside window).
Optional role update is limited to NAC-Default/unassigned roles; the role becomes a User/Host Profile filter.

targets.notes: Current guide explicitly recommends FAC SAML IdP proxy for Azure Government; commercial Azure OAuth source hardcodes graph.microsoft.com and does not support graph.microsoft.us. Older cookbook is flow illustration only.

targets.notes: Reconciliation is limited to Active Directory LDAP password changers and affects manual, automatic and check-in password changes.
